name: briefing_desk
description: Turns an incoming request for input into a reviewed, cited reply. Sending it out requires a person's approval; publishing is switched off.

mcp_servers.name: evidence
mcp_servers.note: The policy-evidence-mcp server (a separate repository): reached by URL when GOVAGENTS_EVIDENCE_MCP_URL is set (as in a deployment), otherwise launched locally. Its tools declare themselves read-only, so they are classified as read.

agents.name: intake
agents.purpose: Log the request and turn it into a structured brief.
instructions: Read the request. Log it with tracker_create (title, requester email, deadline, topic).
Then finish with the case id and the questions the reply must answer.

agents.name: researcher
agents.purpose: Collect evidence for each question, with a citation for every item.
instructions: For each question in the brief, search for evidence. Keep only what the sources say.
Every evidence item needs the citation returned by the tool. List questions you could not answer as gaps.

agents.name: drafter
agents.purpose: Write the reply from the evidence only.
instructions: Write a short reply (under 200 words) that answers the questions using only the evidence items, citing each as [n] with a numbered source list at the end.
If a reviewer listed issues in the case file, fix all of them. Save it with save_draft, then finish.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.purpose: Check that every statement in the draft is supported by a cited evidence item.
instructions: Compare the draft with the evidence items. Approve only if every factual statement is supported and cited, and the questions are answered or the gaps are stated.

agents.name: dispatcher
agents.purpose: Send the approved reply to the requester and close the case.
instructions: If the reviewer approved the draft, email it to the requester with send_email, then set the case status to 'sent' with tracker_update.
If the reviewer did not approve it, do not send anything: set the status to 'needs attention' and explain.
